category_title: Younger preschoolers engaging in sensory-heavy, chaotic pretend play
scenario_title: Sensory-heavy pretend play escalating into chaos
minimal_context: A group of preschoolers is in the dramatic play area building a tent out of sheets and blankets during morning free play.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It looks like you are gathering a lot of sheets and blankets in the dramatic play area.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Let’s make a tent! (Isaac and Martina pull several large sheets and blankets and drape them over an upended wooden structure.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You are bringing a lot of items over to the tent.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Tucker, Josefa, and Bonnie fill a pushcart with every dish, plastic food item, and scrap of play money they can carry, and dump it all into the tent on top of the others.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you going to do with all that food inside the tent?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The children crawl back into the tent and noisily pretend to eat. They make loud gnashings and growlings, acting ravenous and animalistic as they gather large amounts of small plastic toys in their arms and throw the plastic food hither and yon in the air.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It looks like you are gathering a lot of sheets and blankets in the dramatic play area.

STUDENT: Let’s make a tent! (Isaac and Martina pull several large sheets and blankets and drape them over an upended wooden structure.)

TUTOR: What are you going to do with all that food inside the tent?

STUDENT: (The children crawl back into the tent and noisily pretend to eat. They make loud gnashings and growlings, acting ravenous and animalistic as they gather large amounts of small plastic toys in their arms and throw the plastic food hither and yon in the air.)

task.content: Initiating the 'Sleeping Family Game' and building a tent

context.environment: dramatic play area during the two-hour morning free play period
context.materials: several large sheets and blankets, upended wooden structure, pillows, seat cushions, long scarves, pushcart, plastic food item, play money, dress-up shoes, beaded necklaces, hats, clothes and plastic baby dolls
context.social_setting: Group play with Bonnie, Tucker, Martina, Isaac and Josefa

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: ravenous and animalistic, with loud gnashings and growlings as they and throw the plastic food hither and yon, gathering large amounts of these small plastic toys in their arms and throwing them in the air inside the tent.
related_quotes: You are our kitty and puppy

behavior_patterns.condition: announced that it was time to clean up
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: trudged slowly and wearily and complained that they did not know how to put things away, and that they were hungry or needed to use the toilet.
